title: Machine learning algorithm with point-of-care troponin I rules out myocardial infarction
summary: Safety and efficacy of direct rule-out were compared with guideline pathways in 2560 patients pooled from two prospective cohorts in the USA and Australia. The analysis is retrospective and the figures were not read.
ai_technology: ARTEMIS machine learning algorithm estimating MI probability from one point-of-care hs-cTnI measurement

evidence.tested: Two prospective cohorts, USA and Australia
evidence.unknown: Retrospective analysis; figures not read; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ARTEMIS ML algorithm uses single point-of-care hs-cTnI to rule out myocardial infarction

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
